watchlist_reason: High-reliability imaging, sensing, instrumentation, defense and space compounder; watch backlog conversion, organic margins, cash flow, debt reduction, acquisition discipline, and valuation after the Q2 breakout.
research_summary: Record Q2 orders, sales, operating profit, backlog and cash flow support Teledyne's quality, but the USD 684.76 mark exceeds base and weighted fair value and leaves the security allocation-ineligible.
